title: Flight 19 and the lost PBY from Banana River
place_text: Banana River Naval Air Station (later Patrick AFB), Florida / Bermuda Triangle

tellings.quote: I talked to some of the guys that were in flight ops on that day

plain: In 1945 a Navy training flight called Flight 19 was lost off Florida, in the stretch of ocean known as the Bermuda Triangle, along with a PBY, a Navy flying boat, from Banana River Naval Air Station, the base later called Patrick Air Force Base. A former NASA doctor named Greg Rogers brings the story up and says he spoke to some of the men who were working in flight operations that day. He offers their memories as a firsthand link to one of the region's best-known disappearances.
